tabs.content:
.create table e015_website_visits (
    visit_id: string,
    visit_timestamp: datetime,
    page: string 
) 

.ingest inline into table e015_website_visits with (format = 'csv') <|
"v001","2025-01-01T09:15:00Z","Home"
"v002","2025-01-01T11:30:00Z","Contact"
"v003","2025-01-02T14:45:00Z","Home"
"v004","2025-01-03T08:05:00Z","Pricing"
"v005","2025-01-03T20:10:00Z","Blog"

e015_website_visits
| order by visit_timestamp asc 

// Create a Materialized View without backfill
.create async materialized-view with (
    docString  = "Daily website visits without backfill"
) e015_mv_daily_web_visits_no_backfill
on table e015_website_visits
{
    e015_website_visits
    | extend visit_day = bin(visit_timestamp, 1d)
    | summarize visit_count = count() by visit_day
}

// Query mv witouth backfill
e015_mv_daily_web_visits_no_backfill 

// Create MV WITH backfill
.create async materialized-view with (
    backfill  = true,
    effectiveDateTime = datetime(2024-12-01T00:00:00Z),
    docString = "Daily visits with backfill"
) e015_mv_daily_web_visits_with_backfill
on table e015_website_visits
{
    e015_website_visits
    | extend visit_day = bin(visit_timestamp, 1d)
    | summarize  visit_count = count() by visit_day
}

// Query mv view with backfill
e015_mv_daily_web_visits_with_backfill
| order by visit_day asc 

// Show materialized view in the database
.show materialized-views 

// More Ingestions
.ingest inline into table e015_website_visits with (format = 'csv') <|
"v006","2025-01-04T10:10:00Z","Home"
"v007","2025-01-04T12:30:00Z","Contact"

// Quey table agaiin
e015_website_visits
| order by visit_timestamp asc 


e015_mv_daily_web_visits_no_backfill
| order by visit_day asc 
;
e015_mv_daily_web_visits_with_backfill
| order by visit_day asc 

//Create a simple function to get website visits for a given page
.create-or-alter function get_daily_visits_per_page(pageName:string)
{
    e015_website_visits
    | where page  == pageName
    | extend visit_day = bin(visit_timestamp, 1d)
    | summarize visit_count = count() by visit_day
}

// qUERY THE FUNCTION TO SEE VISTIS TO THE home page
get_daily_visits_per_page("Home")
| order by visit_day asc 

// drop kql database itemns
.drop materialized-view e015_mv_daily_web_visits_no_backfill ifexists
.drop materialized-view e015_mv_daily_web_visits_with_backfill ifexists
